findings.title: Queries are interpolated twice in the shard-splitting path
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery() now calls datasource.applyTemplateVariables() on every target, and then passes the resulting (already interpolated) targets down to runSplitQuery() (line 163), which in querySplitting.ts:299 applies applyTemplateVariables() again to each target. Any non-idempotent part of applyTemplateVariables — notably ad-hoc filter / scope injection into the LogQL selector and label-filter addition — will be applied twice, producing duplicated filters in the final expression (and, with the shard selector already injected, interpolation runs over an expression that already contains `__stream_shard__`). The new test asserting `applyTemplateVariables` is called 5 times for a single target (shardQuerySplitting.test.ts:112) documents this repeated interpolation rather than preventing it. Interpolation should happen once; e.g. pass a flag/option to runSplitQuery to skip re-interpolation when called from the shard splitter.
